chart.description: Packet error rate and drop rate
chart.name: Network health
Datacenter health
chart.programText:
H = data('vcenter.datacenter.host.count').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='H')
G = data('vcenter.datacenter.vm.count').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='G')
A = data('vcenter.datacenter.cpu.limit').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='A')
J = data('vcenter.*.cpu.usage').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='J')
L = ((J/A)*100).publish(label='L')
D = data('vcenter.datacenter.memory.limit').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='D')
M = data('vcenter.*.memory.usage').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='M')
O = ((M/D)*100).floor().publish(label='O')
I = data('vcenter.datacenter.disk.space').sum(by=['vcenter.datacenter.name']).publish(label='I')
